email.subject: Try your handbook questions in Slack
email.preview_text: A concrete first step for your team
email.body:
If colleagues ask the same policy questions in Slack, try answering one from the document itself.

Relay lets you build an agent that answers from uploaded documents in Slack. Upload a policy, connect Slack through OAuth and choose the channel for your test.

Ask a question whose answer you already know, then decide whether the reply is useful. That is a test of your material, not a promise that every question will be answered correctly.

Analytics also records daily aggregate spend automatically, so you can inspect usage during the test. Start with a free account; no card is required.

notes: Synthetic qualitative fixture; evidence is defined for this case, not a claim about a real product.
Access to answers is the primary promise; accounting supports the test. Aggregate spend does not license cost per answer.
Variants are editorial contrasts, not pipeline before/after outputs. Model preferences are not measured marketing outcomes.
